origins.section: The Winner on the Training Set Looks Better Than It Is
Hold Out Whole Groups the Tuner Never Sees
Gurobi's Tuning Tool Runs the Same Search on the Clock

recorded.prompt:q-winner: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-winner: Taking the minimum of eighteen such numbers picks the configuration whose luck was best, so the winning score is biased low by construction.
recorded.prompt:q-split: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-split: So split by group: decide the groups first (here, the portfolio seed), then put whole groups on each side.
recorded.prompt:q-tool: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-tool: The page masks what the tool found, because the tool times its trials on the clock ... **Its suggestion is a training-set result.** ... test it on held-out groups with your own deterministic measure before adopting it.
